title: Content Gap Report
description: Emitted by Content Production Agent (A08) when a brief cannot be executed honestly because source material does not exist. This is a normal, expected, correct output. A gap is never resolved by writing around it: producing a plausible paragraph where a visit record should be is the failure this agent is designed to prevent.

source_requirement.description: ai_structurable sections cannot produce a gap; they are writable from the brief alone.

why_it_cannot_be_written.description: e.g. 'No visit record exists for this shrine; writing the atmosphere would be AI-originated first-hand experience.'

what_would_resolve_it.description: The specific material needed, e.g. 'visit notes including December approach conditions and photo inventory'.

is_structural.description: True when the piece's core rests on this section. Any structural gap forces blocking = true.

blocking.description: true = the piece cannot proceed at all. false = the rest of the draft is deliverable with gapped sections marked status: awaiting_source.

escalated_to.description: A gap that puts a seasonal deadline at risk is escalated to the human immediately, not queued.
